description: This PHP script handles the server-side logic for saving mail merge documents in SuiteCRM, including retrieving module data, preparing merge templates, and executing the merge process.

classes.name: MailMerge
classes.description: A class responsible for performing mail merge operations, including setting data and field lists, executing the merge, and cleaning up temporary files.

classes.name: Documents
classes.description: A bean representing document records, used for retrieving document metadata like filename and revision ID.

methods.name: SetDataList
methods.description: Sets the list of data items to be used in the mail merge.

methods.name: SetFieldList
methods.description: Sets the list of fields to include in the merge.

methods.name: Template
methods.description: Specifies the template files to be used for the merge.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Performs the mail merge process and returns the resulting file.

methods.name: CleanUp
methods.description: Removes temporary files created during the merge process.
